up: Retrieve all compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5729040'. For each compound, return its ChEMBL identifier (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), and the compound key from the compound_records table (compound_records.compound_key). Use the docs table to identify the document by matching docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5729040', then join compound_records on doc_id, and then join molecule_dictionary on molregno. Do not apply any additional filters beyond the document identifier. Return distinct compounds if a compound appears multiple times in the document.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  cr.compound_key
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5729040';
